text: Wærenskjold executed a audacious late move to steal the stage in a record-breaking sprint finish, while UAE's relentless chase tactics—hunting down Carapaz's breakaway and bleeding time from rivals—kept Pogačar's stranglehold on yellow intact. Vingegaard held his own on a deceptively fast day, limiting losses to just 3:36, though the GC battle remains Pogačar's to lose with a commanding advantage as the race enters its second half.
